1.title: How Trump’s Trade War Could Hurt Republican Efforts to Hold the Senate
1.summary: In a handful of border states and industrial states that could decide Senate control, the president’s standoff with Canada has drawn criticism from voters, including some who supported him in 2024.

2.title: Sherrod Brown Tries a New Retort to Criticism on Transgender Issues
2.summary: A spot from the Senate candidate in Ohio seeks to dismiss the Republican Party’s focus on transgender rights as a distraction from economic issues.

3.title: Man Charged in Maryland Boy’s Disappearance After 33 Years
3.summary: A 61-year-old man has been charged with murder in the death of 10-year-old George Burdynski Jr., whose case shocked a Maryland neighborhood.

4.title: A Small Country’s Huge Windfall from the War in Iran
4.summary: Oil-rich Guyana is enjoying red-hot growth. But the boom is magnifying tensions over corruption, inequality and strained ties with Venezuela.

5.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
5.summary: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.

6.title: Reported Explosions Put Saudi Capital on Edge Amid Conflict With Houthis
6.summary: The Saudi authorities issued emergency alerts as several booms rattled parts of Riyadh, and local flights were disrupted. The cause of the blasts was not immediately clear.
